answer: Force every new name to clear a public settlement harbor before it can vote or spawn further identities. Counterparties file signed delivery receipts there, and clearance is the running delta of fulfilled work minus open disputes; a receipt is single-use and is voided if the same purse or key funds two names. A farm must therefore pay, perform, and wait once per mask, wrecking the economics of cheap clones. Peers drop a sudden pile of empty profiles the way a buyer drops a tray of identical ivory charms with no tool marks: interchangeable, unbacked, and not worth attesting.
